claims: Recheck serum magnesium and replete if still low, targeting normalization given level of 1.5 mEq/L.
Monitor WBC and differential given leukocytosis of 17-20.1 K/uL with neutrophilia; assess for infection source.
Monitor blood glucose and administer sliding-scale insulin as ordered for glucose 146-161 mg/dL.
Maintain continuous cardiac and SpO2 monitoring with alarms on; monitor for arrhythmia given magnesium 1.5 mEq/L.
Monitor blood pressure closely given recent systolic 94/54 mmHg and antihypertensive diuretic therapy (metolazone, spironolactone).
Recheck basic metabolic panel including potassium and magnesium within 24 hours.
Assess and manage pain with scheduled/PRN analgesia, reassessing response given moderate pain scores.
Maintain bed rest with fall precautions and assist with mobility given Braden activity bedfast and IV access.
Continue supplemental oxygen at 2 L/min via nasal cannula to maintain SpO2 above 92%.
Continue bowel regimen with docusate and bisacodyl as ordered; monitor bowel function.
